description_expanded: Overview5.0(6 reviews)INLET BEACH – Blue Fin Luxury Home | Private Heated Pool & Spa | Sleeps 26 DESCRIPTION Blue Fin is an exquisite luxury retreat, designed for ultimate relaxation and privacy. With 8 spacious bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 1 half-bath, this home comfortably accommodates up to 26 guests. Located at the end of a quiet road and just ¾ mile from Rosemary Beach, this retreat offers both tranquility and access to excellent shops and restaurants nearby. Indulge in the beauty of a chef’s kitchen, high-end finishes, and a private pool area perfect for making memories with family and friends. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax in the private heated pool or enjoy the spacious patio area, perfect for unwinding under the Florida sun. Beach access is steps away via the Lupine Beach Neighborhood Beach Walkover (note: includes stairs and is not handicap accessible). HOME FEATURES 8 bedrooms | 8 full bathrooms & 1 half-bath | Sleeps 26 Private heated pool and spacious outdoor patio Chef’s kitchen with top-tier appliances High-end finishes throughout the home Smart TVs, and WiFi Pet friendly (additional pet fee applies) DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Close to 30A dining Nearby boutique shopping, and restaurants Secluded Inlet Beach location with easy access to the Gulf Situated at the end of the road, with the breathtaking Camp Helen State Park to the east, you'll relish tranquility and seclusion. WHY STAY HERE? Perfect for large families or group getaways Luxury design with ample space to relax and entertain Tranquil location with easy access to local attractions Enjoy a getaway where everyone, including your well-behaved fur baby, feels right at home. Elevator for added comfort and convenience SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 6 King bedrooms Third-floor bedroom with 2 King beds and 2 Queen beds Fourth-floor bedroom with two Queen beds Bonus Sleeper sofa in the game room on the first level and an additional sleeper sofa located on the top floor in the living room Blue Fin is more than a vacation home. It’s an exceptional retreat designed for unforgettable moments and luxurious coastal living on 30A. Please Note: The neighborhood is growing, and with that comes a bit of construction nearby, including in front of the house. While it’s entirely out of our control, we always want to be upfront so there are no surprises. We appreciate your understanding as this beautiful area continues to develop.Show less
